description: Test file using Vitest framework to verify lazy loading behavior of 'zca-js' module within 'zca-client' implementation. It contains test cases that mock module imports and validate object creation and method calls.

classes.name: MockZalo
classes.description: A mock class used within the test to simulate the 'Zalo' class from the 'zca-js' module.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for 'zca-client runtime loading'.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test case checking that 'zca-js' is not imported until a session is created.

methods.name: vi.clearAllMocks
methods.description: Clears all mock states before test execution.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates a mock function to substitute the 'zca-js' module's export.

methods.name: vi.doMock
methods.description: Mocks the module import behavior for 'zca-js'.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Dynamically imports the 'zca-client.js' module during the test.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertions to verify behavior, such as function call counts and object matching.

ctags.name: client
ctags.pattern: /^    const client = await zcaClient.createZalo({ logging: false, selfListen: true });$/
